free_tier.stated: No free tier on the vendor site: 'EasyDebrid is a service optimized to be used with apps.' The landing page offers only 'Get Started' into the dashboard.

per_object_cap.stated: not stated on the vendor page read

retention.stated: not stated on the vendor page read; a debrid caches resolved files for the account rather than storing them

egress.terms: The vendor page publishes no byte allowance. Plans are sold through a reseller at '1 Month Plan (30 Days) $4.5' and '1 Year Plan (365 Days) $40', each described only as 'Fast - Distributed CDN PoPs across the world'.

interface_detail: REST API at https://easydebrid.com/api/v1 with 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY' (key from the dashboard, or OAuth 2.0 with PKCE where the access token is the key); documented endpoints: user/details, link/lookup, link/generate. Plus a torrent downloader at downloader.hostyour.app.
tooling: Named as a TorBox/RD alternative in Stremio and debrid-manager comparisons; three independent third-party guides describe it as multi-IP, which is the rare property among debrids. No client code was read here.
chaining: At $4.50 a month it is the cheapest paid debrid found, and the annual at $40 is $3.33 a month. If multi-IP holds, it is the one debrid a client can use from two machines at once without a ban.

limits.value: unstated; plans are sold by period only

limits_note: No fair-use figure, no concurrent-stream cap and no per-day byte count appears on either the vendor page or the reseller page. The absence is the finding: a debrid with no published limit is bounded by whatever the operator enforces silently.
binding_note: Nothing in the vocabulary is stated, so nothing can be named as binding from the evidence. The practical bound is the same as any debrid's: cached availability and silent fair-use enforcement, neither of which is published.

identity_cost.detail: Account at easydebrid.com from an email address alone ('If the email exists, you will be logged in. Otherwise, a new account will be created.'), with email verification and no password; paid plans are bought through the reseller paradise-cloud.com, whose payment methods were not read.

reliability_note: Third-party reviewers report weak customer support and thin link sources, and one review says the operator is Singapore-based, which is why it survived the EU enforcement that cut the French debrids' caches.
confidence_note: The price comes from the reseller page the vendor's own flow points at; the vendor page itself carries no price. The multi-IP claim is third-party and unverified. Opening the account page or the API docs would raise this.

evidence.proved: the vendor describes itself only as 'optimized to be used with apps', claims 'a huge cache of sources', and publishes no price or allowance
the two plans: '1 Month Plan (30 Days) $4.5' and '1 Year Plan (365 Days) $40', plus 'Distributed CDN PoPs across the world'
the vendor publishes a REST API with Bearer authentication
evidence.quote: The EasyDebrid API allows you to integrate our debrid service into your applications.

evidence.proved: sign-in and sign-up are one email-only form

price_per_tb_month: USD 4.50 per 30 days, no volume figure published
notes: The vendors' own page is unusually thin: no price, no limits, no host list. That thinness is itself the risk.
